data.reply: Hi, thanks for reaching out and sorry for the trouble. We understand the critical nature of this issue, with agents unable to see their assigned tickets, and we are here to help. Please have the affected agents clear their browser cache and cookies and then sign back into CloudDesk. If the problem persists, an administrator can resolve it by reassigning the ticket to another agent, saving the change, and then reassigning it back to the original agent. This should immediately restore visibility for your team. [T-2795] Let us know if that does not resolve it.
